name: reference-rtx4060-128gb
description: Reference machine: RTX 4060 8 GB, i9-14900KF, 128 GiB DDR5-4200, Windows 11
provenance: The machine every constant in llamafit/constants.py was fitted to and every `measured` block in the bundled catalog was taken on, so that a stranger can reproduce the documentation's numbers without it. CPU, memory sizes, GPU name, VRAM and driver are the recorded probe output in tests/fixtures/reference_machine.py, captured 2026-09-09; the memory type, speed and channel count are from docs/calibration/2026-09-09-reference-machine.md, which also records the llama.cpp build and every run the constants come from. The 57.0 GB/s figure is the NumPy read benchmark on that machine (llamafit/hardware/bandwidth.py and constants.py; a live run on the day reported 57.3, and 57.0 is the figure the estimator was derived against). The card's 272 GB/s and 15 TFLOPS are deliberately absent: they are vendor specifications and come from the bundled GPU table, which is the same source a live scan uses. No calibration block: this machine's fitted constants are in llamafit/constants.py, where they are applied, and a second copy here would be a copy nothing reads and nothing keeps in step.
